nodes.label: Web Splash Screen Dark Mode 1x (AshaSathi Logo)
nodes.description: Web splash screen image for dark mode at 1x pixel density. Displays the AshaSathi custom brand logo: bold green uppercase text 'ASHA' on the top row and 'SATHI' on the bottom row, with a stylized house/home icon integrated above the 'A' in 'ASHA'. The house icon has a pointed roof with a small window, reinforcing the housing/shelter theme. Color scheme is solid green (#2E7D32 or similar medium-dark green) on a white background.
